title: Woman by Vintage Car at Roadside Stand, 1948 B&W Snapshot Photo
description: A black and white snapshot taken on July 5, 1948, featuring a young woman standing outdoors in shorts and a top holding a treat. Behind her is a late-1940s classic car with its hood open and whitewall tires, parked outside a roadside concession stand or diner building. A man stands in profile near the service counter. This photo offers a candid glimpse into post-WWII American road trip culture and summer leisure.
